name: Contraptions 29: random tree circuit (16x16) (Momentum Bubbles 18)
description: A closed circuit on a random tree curve (the loop round a random spanning tree of 8x8 blocks, seed 7: it visits every cell, and closes), 256 gates at 512², each aiming at the next and the last at the first, so it never crosses the frame's edge: 128 dots (radius 3 cells) start at rest in every other gate, which launch them round and round. Gates: brake, accel 0.002, aim_speed 0.025. Gates show as the aim channel in the custom palette.
